source.title: Align C2 preparation with non-prompt child executor starts and local-only repositories
source.objective: C2 preparation workflow mismatch: executor_start on a non-prompt child item marks it running, but c2_prepare_codex.py only accepts pending items; additionally this local-only repo has no Git remote, so c2_prepare_codex cannot allocate an external worktree.
